About Us (Faded Archive)

Faded Archive is a shop for made‑to‑order tees, proudly from Manchester. Each shirt is hand‑printed on request, ensuring you receive a fresh, unique design that reflects your own style. We source quality cotton and work with ethical suppliers, so every tee is as sustainable as it is stylish. Whether you’re looking for a bold statement or a subtle nod to your favourite sub‑culture, Faded Archive delivers that perfect fit, finished right here in Manchester—ready to ship straight from our own boutique.

Logo colour: a deep charcoal‑black; it keeps the design timeless and versatile across all digital and print media.
